title: BillingMoneyReason
description: billing.money-reason@1: why a movement of OpenCoins, Vibes or Balance happened, in the words a person reads. `key` is the raw ledger reason (OpenCoins reason, or Billing's type:metadata); `text` is the phrase without the amount ("for the quest Publish a video"), so a page writes "+15 OpenCoins" before it; `subject` is the thing it was for and where to read it, when there is one. A key nobody declared reads "for something on <site>", has known: false, and is never shown as its key. Same reason kinds, one list: openvibe-contracts/lib/money-reasons.js.

key.description: The ledger's own reason, kept for support and logs. A page never prints it.

text.description: The plain phrase, without the amount: "for the quest Publish a video".

subject.description: What the movement was for (a quest, a stream, a tip, a creator, an app, a project, a purchase), with its own name and address. Null when the reason has no page of its own.

site.description: The site the movement belongs to, in the words a person reads (OpenVibe.Quest, OpenVibe.Live, OpenVibe).

known.description: False for a key no kind declares; its text says "for something on <site>".
